title: ByteDance Restructures Its AI Business Landscape: Large Model ARR Reaches $4 Billion, Integrated with Collaboration and Core Large Models

content_html:
On July 30, ByteDance announced a major restructuring of its artificial intelligence business organization, splitting the team behind its collaboration office application, Feishu, into two parts, which were respectively integrated into the Doubao and Volcano Engine teams. This move aims to further strengthen the synergy between large model products and cloud services in enterprise productivity scenarios.

According to the information, the core of this organizational adjustment lies in breaking down departmental barriers. The Feishu product team will be officially integrated with the Doubao product team to form a new Doubao product team, which will be comprehensively managed by Zhao Qi, the head of Doubao. Feishu's original leader, Xie Xin, will report to Zhao Qi. At the same time, the remaining team members have been connected with Volcano Engine, accelerating commercialization and technological empowerment.

In terms of business growth, ByteDance revealed its latest financial performance. According to the average consumption calculation for July this year, the annualized revenue run rate of its large model business has reached 4 billion US dollars, a figure that surpasses the total of other domestic large model companies, demonstrating strong market momentum and commercialization capabilities.

content_html_zh:
7月30日，字节跳动宣布对人工智能业务组织进行重大重组，将协同办公应用飞书背后的团队拆分为两部分，分别整合到豆宝和火山引擎团队。 此举旨在进一步加强大模型产品与云服务在企业生产力场景下的协同。

据了解，本次组织调整的核心在于打破部门壁垒。 飞书产品团队将与豆宝产品团队正式整合，组建新的豆宝产品团队，由豆宝负责人赵琪全面管理。 Feishu's original leader, Xie Xin, will report to Zhao Qi. 同时，剩余团队成员已与火山引擎对接，加速商业化和技术赋能。

在业务增长方面，字节跳动披露了最新的财务业绩。 按照今年7月平均消费计算，其大模型业务年化营收运行率已达40亿美元，这一数字超过国内其他大模型公司的总和，展现出强劲的市场动力和商业化能力。
